frame.horizontal: ENU tangent plane at the origin on GRS80 (geodetic -> ECEF -> ENU, ECEF origin evaluated at horizontal_origin_height_m); x east, y north; no curvature term. Origin CRS EPSG:6668 (JGD2011 geographic 2D) and source CRS EPSG:6697 (JGD2011 geographic 2D + JGD2011 height) share the JGD2011 horizontal datum on GRS80, so the source latitude/longitude are used as published with no horizontal transformation and no translation from any other frame
frame.vertical: none: no vertical datum and origin.hM is null on purpose. The frame defines x/y only. Each context feature is flattened to symbolic street z = 0 by subtracting its own ground height (its CityGML ground-height attribute when it carries one, else the minimum source height of the LOD geometry actually drawn for that feature; never one constant for all features): z_local = z_source - groundHeight(feature). Source heights are EPSG:6697 orthometric (TP) and are only ever used as differences within one feature.
frame.axis_order: source latitude,longitude,height; station x east, y north, z up; glTF (renderer) x east, y up, z -north
frame.purpose: Station reference frame (docs/core/contract.md Frames) for visual-only context geometry; NOT an envelope processing origin and NOT a routing frame

window.rule: The window is the union of closed discs in the station frame: R_origin around the origin plus R_exit around every graph node whose kind is in node_rule.exit_kinds (exit connector) or whose floorId is in node_rule.street_floor_ids (street-level node). A feature is selected when its XY bbox meets any disc. With node_rule.exit_poi_connectors, every graph node that pois.json names in connectorNodeIds of a POI whose category is an exit category also gets a disc (an exit whose connector is a stair foot instead of a street node). With node_rule.poi_ids, exactly the graph nodes that pois.json names in connectorNodeIds of the listed POI ids get a disc (an id missing from pois.json, or a POI with no resolvable connector node, fails the run). R_origin 0 adds no origin disc.

selection_rule: A top-level bldg:Building / tran:Road is selected when the XY bounding box of all its polygon vertices (every LOD) in the station frame intersects any closed disc of the window (the union of a disc of R_origin around the frame origin and a disc of R_exit around each exit connector / street-level graph node). Selected features are converted whole; geometry is never cut at the window edge. The window is the union of closed discs in the station frame: R_origin around the origin plus R_exit around every graph node whose kind is in node_rule.exit_kinds (exit connector) or whose floorId is in node_rule.street_floor_ids (street-level node). A feature is selected when its XY bbox meets any disc. With node_rule.exit_poi_connectors, every graph node that pois.json names in connectorNodeIds of a POI whose category is an exit category also gets a disc (an exit whose connector is a stair foot instead of a street node). With node_rule.poi_ids, exactly the graph nodes that pois.json names in connectorNodeIds of the listed POI ids get a disc (an id missing from pois.json, or a POI with no resolvable connector node, fails the run). R_origin 0 adds no origin disc.
lod_policy: Buildings: LOD2 where the building has lod2Solid or a lod2MultiSurface boundary (all inline LOD2 polygons incl. installations), else LOD1; LOD0 is never converted; one LOD per building (a building whose LOD2 solid references do not all resolve to its own inline LOD2 polygons falls back to LOD1, never a mix). Roads: LOD3 only, because LOD1/LOD2 road geometry is flat at z=0; roads without LOD3 height are excluded and counted; no ground height is ever synthesised.
textures: not converted: PLATEAU texture lineage is aerial photography and its licence is unassessed
modifications: building bases flattened to street level
modification_notice: Modified from the source: building bases flattened to street level (z_local = z_TP - per-feature ground height; symbolic street z = 0; no vertical datum)

ground_offsets.subtracted: groundHeight(feature) in source (TP) metres, rounded to 1 mm in these statistics; the per-feature value is in the feature table
ground_offsets.rule: z_local = z_TP - groundHeight(feature), per feature, never one constant for all features. Buildings, in priority order: (1) ground_height_attribute: the feature's own CityGML ground-height attribute when it carries one of the configured generic attributes; (2) ground_surface_lod2: when LOD2 is drawn and the building has bldg:GroundSurface polygons, the minimum z of those polygons (their max - min spread is recorded per building), so a sunken entrance or light well in the walls cannot pull the base down; (3) lod1_solid_bottom: the minimum z of the building's lod1Solid, even when LOD2 is drawn; (4) min_z_of_drawn_lod: the minimum source height over the triangulated polygons of the LOD drawn. Roads: min_z_of_drawn_lod. Relative heights inside one feature are unchanged.

exit_neighbours.rule: Per window POI (node_rule.poi_ids): the converted buildings whose footprint bbox (all vertices of every LOD, horizontal station frame) lies within radius_m of any connector node of that POI (closed distance, bbox to point). Statistics are over the subtracted ground height of those buildings; gml_ids lists them. Roads are not counted. A building near two exits is listed under both.

mesh_coverage.method: JIS X 0410 3rd-level (8 digit) cells, projected into the station frame, tested against every disc of the window (closed; widened by margin_m)
